integrity: The component decomposition, Pauli-mixture lemma, commuting/anticommuting bounds, and two-qubit partial-transpose spectrum were reconstructed directly and replayed with the included checker. No independent external audit has been performed.
limitations: The claim is the exact universal threshold for finite Pauli Hamiltonians with maximum term-overlap degree at most one and coefficient cap |J_i|<=J. It does not optimize unequal weighted coefficients, sampling complexity, or the Delta>=2 regime; a differently phrased older observation about the specific two-qubit witness may exist.
title: Exact degree-one separability threshold for bounded-coefficient Pauli Gibbs states
